content:
We are gearing up for the weekend, and beyond ongoing 25% discounts on AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off AirPods Max 2, today's top story on 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the lowest price we've seen on a 13-inch M5 MacBook Air back in stock at the official Apple Refurbished Store for $1,099, with 3 colorways to choose from ($200 off) — this model tends to sell out quickly. We also have MacBook Neo discounts of up to $120 off compared to new MSRP, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop down to nearly $100 off at Amazon, and the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable on sale at Amazon low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off). Stay tuned for the updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals, also ending soon, all of which you can find below.

Summer AirPods deals continue: Max 2 down to $100 off, AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $149 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $119 (originally $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy refreshes 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen, more

Lowest price 13-inch M5 MacBook Air back in stock at official Apple Refurbished Store for $1,099 in 3 colors ($200 off)

The official Apple Refurbished Store has long been a solid source for savings, especially now with MacBook lineup price increases. But the Pro and M5 MacBook Air base configurations tend to sell out fast, and this morning we spotted the lowest-priced 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in all 3 colors back in stock for $1,099 — that's $200 off the MSRP.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099 (with free shipping). The deal is still live as of writing and applies to Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These machines come with the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Sold after Apple's strict refurbishment process

This is the base configuration of the M5 MacBook Air that retails for $1,299 new. Today's Apple refurb deal at $200 off the new price tag is the best option we've found for the most accessible model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is the Apple Refurbished Store, which is arguably the best source for refurbished MacBook Air on the market, but how does it compare to current retail pricing for new units?

Amazon currently charges close to MSRP for this configuration, with the silver model coming in slightly lower at $1,240. Although this machine has been sold for less in the past, we haven't seen the new unit from Amazon go lower than $1,149 since the price hike, and even that was a very brief deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop now down to nearly $100 off at Amazon

If I had to pick, I'd say two of the most handsome smartwatch combos on the planet are both on sale at Amazon for nearly $100 off right now — Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with Milanese Loop in natural titanium or black.

While the cheaper Ocean Band version's $100 discount has expired, Amazon is now selling the Milanese Loop versions of the Natural or Black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 for $799.99 (with free shipping).

These two configurations have a $899 MSRP thanks to that gorgeous Milanese Loop, and they're now marked down by nearly $100 at Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

Apple is widely expected to debut its next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but with the RAM crunch already hitting the iPad and MacBook lines, new Apple Watch models are very likely the next victims. Current lineup hasn't been affected so far, but they're essentially mini wrist computers, and Ultra 4 / Series 12 might just be the next to take the hit.

We certainly wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait until September to see what else Apple has in store before pulling the trigger, but these could very well cost more in less than a month.

The Series models might be facing the same fate, and they're also down $100 at Amazon right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Grab the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable on Amazon low at $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

While the 240W black model is still in stock at the all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping, grab a few of these 10-foot Beats woven USB-C cables.

Amazon is now selling the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C woven cable for $18.03, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

These 2026 models feature enhanced power delivery ratings and carry a $30 MSRP, which is a steep price even for a premium 10-foot USB-C cable. But at 40% off, I think a few of these premium, stylish cables should be in everyone's everyday carry or home collection.

Today's lowest price is on the Bolt Black model, but there are also Navy for $19, Surge Stone with on-page coupon for $20.85, and the red model coming in at nearly $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous-gen's 60W to a steady 240W power delivery, alongside a longer 10-foot cable length and the same tangle-resistant woven design, "More durable and convenient. Elevate your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, bending, and wear with our reinforced woven cable."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular at $100 off, deals from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand back down to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

I tested it for review when it launched earlier this year, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become an everyday carry, travel bag, and home charging essential for me. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab it at Amazon's lowest price.

Anker's official Amazon store is now selling their latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 (with free shipping).

This charger normally retails for $150, features a 3-in-1 design, with the MagSafe pad supporting up to 25W output, and is currently close to 35% off MSRP. Both Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colors are available.

This week's deal matches what we mentioned before, bringing back Anker's Summer Sale pricing and matching this year's Prime Day prices.

Although this thing is compact and portable enough to take on the go, it does have some heft to it and stands solidly on your desk or nightstand, making it equally handy for work-from-home or on-the-go use.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Belkin's brand new tiny 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable down to just $25
  • Charge everything on your desk for $60 — SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with two built-in cables slashed to $33 (58% off)
  • Acer woven USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable with 240W charging and 8K resolution down to $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display down to just $56 today
  • First deal: Brand-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro lock with Ultra Wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet tracker back at Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone pouch/EDC bag down to $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter covering '200+ countries and regions' down to $20

Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo lowest prices, up to $120 off new MSRP

Beyond MacBook Air and the M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's more affordable new MacBook Neo has also seen a price hike recently, but you can dodge the price increase via the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store — MacBook Neo starts at $689 at Amazon, but you can grab one from the authoritative Apple Refurbished Store with full Apple warranty starting at $599.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store carries all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we've found from a reputable source, with official Apple warranty and Apple's 'strict' refurbishment quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 new)

While you might not see a specific deal when you open the Apple Refurbished Store product pages, each is at least $100 less than new MSRP — the 512GB version with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 less than new MSRP, and an additional $20 less than its previous pricing.

Yes, they're refurbished, and they essentially bring the price back to near or close to previous MSRP, but we're talking about the lowest prices on the most affordable current-generation MacBook right now.

For some, saving $100 to $120 isn't worth specifically opting for a refurbished machine, and that's completely understandable, but it's a significant amount of money, especially considering we're talking about the highest-quality refurbishment goods directly from Apple.
